title: Waterjet / abrasive cutting
description: Waterjet / abrasive cutting capability for titanium components
processDescription: Abrasive waterjet cutting of titanium uses a high-pressure stream of water mixed with garnet abrasive to erode material. The cold-cutting process produces zero heat-affected zone, making it ideal for titanium grades sensitive to thermal cracking, particularly for titanium components. Precision titanium components present unique challenges: balancing dimensional accuracy with cost per part. Process selection (mill vs. turn vs. EDM vs. laser) is optimized for each feature.
heatControl: No heat generated - room temperature waterjet stream. HAZ-free process preserves titanium microstructure.
flatnessControl: No thermal distortion. Flatness depends on incoming stock condition.
capabilitiesDescription: Laser processing capability for Waterjet / abrasive cutting, with precision beam delivery, gas assist systems, and process monitoring for repeatable quality.
